Google publishes 10,000 units/day per project. This build uses one shared server poller so desktop/mobile do not multiply YouTube API calls. Whether one chat read costs 1 unit or 5 changes everything, and the docs and the field disagree, so both are shown. After one real stream, compare the call count here against the project's quota graph: whichever column matches is the true cost.
